property_summary: For any account and any token id on a fresh contract with no mints, c.balanceOf(account, id) must equal the stored balance 0; the mutant instead returns uint160(account), which is nonzero for any nonzero account.

For any account and token id, before any mint/burn activity the balance reported by c.balanceOf is the stored balance, which is initially 0 (the mutant wrongly returns the id itself), so for any fresh account and nonzero id the correct contract returns 0 while the buggy one returns id.

For any account and any existing token id, c.balanceOf(account, id) must return exactly the quantity of that id minted to the account; the mutant shifts the read slot by one, so after a mint it returns a stale/zero balance for at least some (account, id).
